text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and stream disconnects on /v1/stream — rolling paging spike observed. 5xx rate increased from 0.3% -> 6.2% over last 18m. Paging backlog high. Paging: 7m avg queue depth.

Evan (oncall): I'm taking this. Seeing lots of gateway 502/504 and a pile of client cancellations. Reproducing with a long prompt shows chunked responses abruptly close.

Maya (sre): ETA to onboard? any customer-facing impact quantified?

Evan (oncall): CS reported 3 customers with truncated transcripts. Internal metric: streaming_disconnects x10, retries x4. Downstream ingestion retries causing duplicate requests.

CS - Lucas: Confirmed impact for acct "AcmeHealth" and "FinFlow" — both saw incomplete responses and app-level timeouts. They're on dedicated capacity but hit gateway tier.

Sophia (runtime): Which path is failing — gateway vs runtime? traces show 200 at runtime but connection closed by gateway. Suspect chunked transfer or ALB connection close.

Dinesh (eng-runtime): I see gateway logs like: `upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream` and nginx error 502 with `writev() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)`. Also saw `client canceled stream` from proxy layer.

Evan (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) increase ALB idle timeout to 180s 2) scale gateway to absorb bursts 3) toggle streaming_chunked_v2 -> false to force buffered responses for suspected customers 4) enable model fallback to smaller variant for long-running streams to reduce tail latency.

Maya (sre): Do we have a safe feature-flag toggle? ops-bot can flip config in svc configstore.

ops-bot: `flag set streaming_chunked_v2 false --env prod --scope gateway` executed (by Evan).

Evan (oncall): Pushed flag. Also bumping gateway replicas now. Running:
```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deploy gateway --replicas=12
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/gateway
```

Sophia (runtime): Also pushing tiny change to drop `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` for streaming proxy when flag is off. Rolling at 1% canary then full.

Dinesh (eng-runtime): I'm tailing logs for model hosts. Highlight: KV cache eviction spikes around the same time — lots of long contexts. Could be memory pressure causing worker restarts which the gateway interprets as upstream reset.

Evan (oncall): Rolling core patch to increase worker memory limit on model-hosts: `kubectl set resources deploy/model-host --limits=memory=12Gi` (applied).

Maya (sre): ALB timeout increased to 180s. Cloudwatch shows client-side resets drop by ~40% in last 8m. 5xx rate down from 6.2% -> 3.1% but still above baseline.

CS - Lucas: Notified AcmeHealth of temporary degraded streaming and mitigation steps. They're ok with graceful fallback to polling for the next 30m.

Sophia (runtime): Enabling immediate fallback policy: if streaming handshake times out >2s then route to non-streaming endpoint `/v1/generate` with same model but buffered output. Deployed rule in routing layer.

Evan (oncall): Added automatic client-side retry suppression for duplicate retries during mitigation to avoid amplification.

Dinesh (eng-runtime): For repro, here's a minimal curl that triggers the disconnect we saw previously (use --no-buffer to see chunking):
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-large","prompt":"LONG_PROMPT...","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```
You can see connection close mid-stream in the middle of token chunk.

Maya (sre): Good call on routing fallback. Observability note: we need a dashboard tile that shows `streaming_chunked_v2` on/off correlated with 5xx. File a follow-up runbook task.

Evan (oncall): Quick checks now: 5xx rate 2.0% (improving), streaming_disconnects down 65% from peak, dedicated customers report fewer truncations. Remaining errors appear to be concentrated on a specific AZ (us-east-1b).

Sophia (runtime): Focusing infra in us-east-1b — pod restart loop observed for model-host-23 with OOMKilled around 00:42 UTC. We've restarted that host and cordoned it from routing for 12m while we inspect heap/profile.

Dinesh (eng-runtime): Heap dump points to KV cache misconfiguration for long contexts — config `kv_cache.max_entries` was bumped in last deploy and didn't roll out simultaneously to the canary flag. Reverting that change now.

ops-bot: `deploy rollback kv-cache-config v1.12 -> v1.11 --env prod` executed.

Maya (sre): After rollback and host restart, us-east-1b error rate back to baseline in 6m. Global 5xx now 0.6%, streaming disconnects near normal.

Evan (oncall): Summary for handoff to next oncall (Maya):
- Incident: elevated 5xx/timeouts & streaming disconnects due to combination of ALB timeout + kv_cache misconfig causing model-host OOM and gateway upstream resets.
- Mitigations applied: ALB timeout increased -> 180s, scaled/restarted gateway, feature-flagged chunked streaming off, increased model-host memory limits temporarily, rollback kv_cache config, cordoned problematic host, enabled routing fallback to non-streaming endpoint for long streams, suppressed client retries.
- Customer impact: partial truncation for ~3 enterprise customers (AcmeHealth, FinFlow, BetaRetail) — CS notified and polling fallback enabled.
- Current status: errors reduced to near-baseline, all mitigations in prod. Postmortem and action items created.

Maya (sre): Taking post-incident. Will draft postmortem and follow-ups: add streaming health dashboard, automated canary check for kv_cache config drift, stricter mem limits gating on config rollouts, and an incident playbook step to toggle streaming flag.

Evan (oncall): Leaving detailed notes in the incident doc. Handing off to Maya. If anything flares, ping me and I'll rejoin. :thumbsup:

Maya (sre): Thanks Evan. I'll keep monitoring for 2h and kick off a blameless postmortem. tagging @ops-bot to create ticket for runbook updates.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-3241 created: "Postmortem: streaming disconnects & kv_cache config drift" assigned to Maya.

Sophia (runtime): Follow-ups: rework streaming_chunked_v2 behavior to gracefully degrade instead of full toggle, add per-customer streaming timeouts, and investigate KV eviction backpressure.

CS - Lucas: I'll follow up with the affected customers to confirm full recovery.

Evan (oncall): Closing the live thread for now. Recording final metrics in incident doc. Good job everyone.
